reported_context.session_intent: Complete the indoor low-aerobic equivalent after outdoor riding was rejected on logistics and air-quality grounds.

self_gate.respiratory_or_eye_symptoms: No runny nose, sore throat, cough, wheeze, chest tightness or eye irritation.

reported_context.pre_session_food: One scone with cream and one banana; timing before the 18:16 local start was not supplied.
reported_context.athlete_interpretation: The session felt cardiovascularly easy but exposed reduced leg strength or endurance, with severe local burning late in the main block and again during cooldown.

session_contract_review.local_leg_symptom: Bilateral muscular burning, mainly in the glutes and hamstrings.
session_contract_review.local_leg_onset: Approximately 35 minutes into the 40-minute main block.
session_contract_review.cooldown_response: Bilateral glute and hamstring burning was felt again approximately seven minutes into the 10-minute cooldown.
session_contract_review.technical_quality_notes: Indoor seated low-aerobic session; MTB technical fields are not applicable.
session_contract_review.stop_rule_interpretation: The written RPE cap did not separately define global session RPE and local muscular RPE. Clayton reports global RPE 3 and explicitly classifies the stop rule as not triggered. Preserve that outcome; do not retroactively convert the local-leg RPE 9 into a stop-rule override.
session_contract_review.contract_observability_gap: Future steady endurance contracts must specify separate global-RPE and local-leg-RPE ceilings, plus the required action when either ceiling is crossed.
session_contract_review.airway_symptom_status_before_during_and_: No runny nose, sore throat, cough, wheeze, chest tightness or eye irritation reported.
session_contract_review.fluid_fuel_sodium_and_cooling: 700 ml water; one scone with cream and one banana before the session, with timing not yet reported; ceiling-fan cooling was previously prescribed but execution was not reconfirmed in this review.

objective_session_evidence.source: Garmin activity 24121900953 standard activity, split and detailed trace surfaces

main_block.interpretation_guardrail: The active HR source was not resolved by Garmin standard metadata, so decoupling is supportive rather than definitive evidence.

environment_and_hydration.guardrail: Garmin water loss is modeled rather than measured.

coach_contract_audit.dose_alignment: Duration and power matched the written indoor equivalent. Main-block cadence averaged below the prescribed 80-90 rpm range, although cadence rose toward approximately 80 rpm late in the block.
coach_contract_audit.stop_rule_alignment: Athlete explicitly reports not_triggered. The original contract did not define a separate local-muscle RPE ceiling, so the local posterior-chain RPE 9 is an execution-boundary observation, not a retroactive safety-adherence failure.
coach_contract_audit.physiology_interpretation: The bilateral glute and hamstring response is most consistent with acute posterior-chain muscular-endurance or force-durability limitation, plausibly amplified by residual fatigue from the prior day's seated low-cadence torque session. It does not establish loss of maximal strength and is not explained by retained lactate.
coach_contract_audit.next_constraint: Use normally fed, cadence-controlled endurance work with global and local RPE scored separately. Progress duration only after two clean sessions without late posterior-chain burning or cooldown recurrence.
